name: Bugg Off! | Handpoured Soy Candle
shortStory: Bring a fresh, citrusy touch to your outdoor moments with Bugg Off! Infused with citronella oil, this handpoured soy candle fills your surroundings with a fresh, lemony aroma. Perfect for balconies, patios and outdoor gatherings, it combines an uplifting fragrance with thoughtful design. Housed in an upcycled beer bottle, each candle gives discarded glass a new purpose.

note.title: A Note on Uniqueness
note.content:
Each candle is handcrafted with care. Subtle variations in colour, texture and appearance are natural characteristics of soy wax and upcycled glass, making every piece unique.
Each upcycled container is thoughtfully renewed and transformed into a candle. Your candle may arrive in either of the two designs shown, depending on availability.

sections.title: Key Features
sections.content:
• Candle Type: Handcrafted Scented Candle
• Wax: Natural Soy Wax
• Wick: Cotton Wick
• Fragrance: Citronella
• Container: Upcycled Beer Bottle
• Burn Time: Approximately 60–80 hours
• Shelf Life: 18 months
• Net Candle Weight: 200 g
• Gross Weight: 490 g, including packaging
• Packaging Dimensions: 8.7 cm diameter (round cardboard box)
• Ships from Goa within 2-3 working days, thoughtfully packed in recycled cardboard packaging.

sections.title: Candle Care
sections.content:
• Before Each Use: Trim the wick to approximately ¼ inch (6 mm) to encourage a cleaner, more even burn.
• Choose the Right Spot: Place the candle on a stable, heat-resistant surface, away from drafts and flammable objects.
• Burn Responsibly: Always keep the candle within sight and do not burn for more than 2 hours at a time.
• Keep It Safe: Keep out of reach of children and pets.
• Handle with Care: Never move the candle while lit or while the wax is hot. Allow it to cool completely before handling.
• Preserve the Fragrance: Replace the lid once the candle has cooled completely to help retain its fragrance between uses.
• Care for Your Glass: A white film may occasionally develop on the glass. Apply a light coating of oil with a soft cloth to help restore its matte appearance.
